latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: prevent group selection from collapsing layout tables by @people-sea in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20938
* fix: preserve image alignment in rendered prose by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20940
* fix: render the static menu ARIA attributes of grouped actions on the server by @webard in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20937
* Fix: only cascade action group visibility cache clearing after calling an action by @webard in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20936
* Add missing Czech translations for JavaScript components by @kojdad-alt in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20949
* feat: allow configuring CSV import encoding by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20951
* fix: render grouped table headers and summaries as list items by @people-sea in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20950
* Translate missing keys to Spanish (js fields) by @luisprmat in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20953
* fix: delay retries for overlapping import chunks by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20955
* chore: align form-specific API naming by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20956
* fix: avoid empty group list items by @people-sea in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20954
* fix: preserve policy response statuses on resource pages by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20957
* fix: collapsible content layout drops group and selection classes on records by @wit3 in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20952
* Fix dropdown closing on window resize after opening it from its trigger by @jayhemnani9910 in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20966
* Keep global search key bindings working after results are rendered by @intrepidws in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20963
* fix: remove empty drop-label space from disabled uploads by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20972
* fix: ignore Enter while an IME is composing text in TagsInput by @cable8mm in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20969
* fix: show placeholders for empty rich content by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20974
* fix: normalize enum record titles by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20973
* fix: correct rich editor image spacing and CSS ownership by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20975
* fix: support latest Rector in v4 upgrades by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20976
* fix: preserve explicitly disabled chart legends by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20977
* fix: resolve nested attachment originals safely by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20978
* fix: respect hidden labels in specialized table summarizers by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20980
* fix: respect SelectColumn option searchability when limiting preloads by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20979
* fix: preserve rich editor mention labels across providers by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20981
* fix: limit each Range summarizer endpoint independently by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20982
* fix: normalize default child content by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20983
* fix: correct PostgreSQL search identifier quoting by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20984
* fix: prevent vertical tab navigation from stretching by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20986
* fix: preserve scroll position when submitting modals inside tabs by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20987

detail.readme: **Filament is an open-source framework for building polished, maintainable business software with Laravel.** From a single admin panel to customer portals, CRMs, and operational systems, Filament gives you components and conventions that work together. Build features that fit your organization, with a consistent experience for your users and less custom code for your team to maintain. Business software isn't just for businesses. Filament helps developers build the systems that companies, charities, schools, and public institutions rely on every day. - **Tables** — Browse, search, and filter records, with customizable columns and individual or bulk actions. - **Forms** — Build reactive forms with reusable components, validation, and flexible layouts. - **Infolists** — Present read-only record details with structured layouts and custom formatting. - **Notifications** — Keep users informed with in-app feedback and persistent notifications. - **Dashboard widgets** — Bring key metrics, charts, and records together in one place. - **Actions** — Connect user interactions to application logic, with support for confirmations, forms, and feedback. [Get Started](https://filamentphp.com/docs) • [Launch Demo](https://demo.filamentphp.com) • [Join Discord](https://filamentphp.com/discord) --- ## Contributing Please see our [contributing guide](https://filamentphp.com/docs/5.x/introduction/contributing). ## Need Help? 🐞 If you spot a bug, please [submit a detailed issue](https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml), and wait for assistance. 🤔 If you have a question or feature request, please [start a new discussion](https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/discussions/new/choose). We also have a [Discord community](https://filamentphp.com/discord). For quick help, ask questions in the appropriate channel. 🔐 If you discover a vulnerability, please review our [security policy](https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/blob/4.x/SECURITY.md).
